answer: Issue new identities through rate-limited, hardware-anchored minting tickets: each fresh agent identity must be minted against an attested compute enclave, and each enclave key is capped at a raven-dark trickle of one identity per week. A public registry keeps a mirror of every ticket ever issued, so a sudden swarm of fake agents shows up as a sable-stained spike no one can hide. Faking ten thousand identities then costs ten thousand enclaves or a decade of waiting — both ruinous, and both visible on-ledger before any damage is done.
